title: Co-op starts after a Ctrl + F6 session; shorter L3 + R3 (DPC 0.9.172-dev50)
intro: Playing the Arisen, co-op off, three controllers on. Each step waits for End.

probes.mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; if D.coop.active then return 'classic' elseif D.R.cp and D.R.cp.on and D.R.s2 and D.R.s2.active then return D.R.cp.mode end; return 'off'
probes.p1: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local t = D and D.R.tp; if not t or not t.p1 then return 'none' end; return t.p1 == D.R.KB_ADDR and 'keyboard' or string.format('controller %X', t.p1 & 0xFFFFFF)
probes.p2: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local t = D and D.R.tp; return (t and t.p2) and string.format('%X', t.p2 & 0xFFFFFF) or 'none'
probes.wait: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.kb_wait() or false
probes.np: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.np_count and D.R.np_count() or 0
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors

steps.text: Get ready: playing the Arisen, co-op off, all three controllers on and awake. Press End.

1. CTRL + F6: press Ctrl + F6, then a friend holds L3 + R3 on a controller. Their pawn should glow blue after about half a second, while they're still holding. Keep holding a few seconds: co-op must NOT end. Let go. Then Ctrl + F6 to end. End when done.

2. PLAYER 1 ON A CONTROLLER (after that keyboard session): walk the Arisen on controller A for a few seconds, then a friend holds L3 + R3 on controller B. Player 1 should keep controller A. End when co-op is on.
3. PLAYER 1 holds L3 + R3 on controller A for 3 seconds: co-op ends (leaving still takes 3 s). End when done.

4. SOLO SAFETY: on controller A alone, press L3 + R3 together briefly (under a second), like sprinting while resetting the camera. Co-op should NOT start (your own controller needs the longer 1.5 s hold). End when done.
Done. Tell Claude how each start felt.
